name: Navajas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, the white charged with a green tree and the blue with a white tower.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 17 June 1998 of the conseller de Presidència, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 3304 of 8 August 1998; it is a flag of 2:3, parted per horizontal half, with a white tower masoned and open in black at the centre of the lower blue half.

features.role: tower masoned and open in black
